method.description: Continuous logistic-normal compositional responses, dimensions3/10, H interior homoscedastic, B boundary heteroscedastic, S covariate shift. Shared train-only ILR ridge center; candidate fits positive residual-scale regression from designated scale training examples only. Evaluator owns calibration, raw L-infinity, Bonferroni, global ILR, uncalibrated training-quantile, full-simplex and singleton geometries. Reliability/efficiency evidence may be negative or inconclusive. No learning/adaptivity/superiority gate is inferred from state flags or aspirational publication claims.

protocol.promotion_rule: At most three charged search evaluations, one per idea cycle. Search.correct requires complete ordinary production execution, strict protocol, all required baseline/control evidence, nonvacuous permutation, constant/global equivalence and terminal reset reproducibility, calibrated geometry, immutable raw-content provenance and finite fixed-weight evidence. No baseline win, significance or comparative threshold. Eligible candidates rank by combined_score descending; exact ties use earliest evaluation index. Harness alone freezes and publishes. Final.correct separately requires full sealed production execution with the same scientific/integrity gates and reproducible paired-seed uncertainty, not superiority. Smoke correctness is false because smoke does not establish full scientific completion. Claims require subsequent evidence review and may be supported, refuted, conditional or inconclusive.

search_proxies.name: three_seed_synthetic_proxy
search_proxies.preserves: All six H3,H10,B3,B10,S3,S10 cases, nominal alpha .05/.10, shared 1024 center/1024 scale/512 calibration/2048 test samples, training-only common center and scale learner, matched controls, genuine baselines, fixed marginal/subgroup/mass utility, independent raw hashes, bounded inline RPC, no targets at prediction. Equal alpha/group weights, equal seeds within case, equal dimensions within family and equal H/B/S families. Separate actual/constant/permutation means; replay has zero performance weight.
search_proxies.omits: Six-seed sealed evidence and final 2000-resample paired-seed score intervals are not search feedback. Synthetic-only benchmark does not establish external real-data validity, intrinsic volume, optimality or conference acceptance. Failure error/mass1 utility0 gap-1 retained at original weights; combined=actual utility*(passed controls/(3*case_seed_count+1)).

search_visible: Public search-only synthetic configuration, designated training covariates/residual norms and prediction covariates through RPC; no calibration/test outcomes, baseline outputs or evaluator paths.

Only aggregate search metric scalars and boolean eligibility after a charged invocation; bounded non-label failure categories. Draft smoke provides structural validation only, never additional scored trials.
final_sealed: Final seeds/streams/examples/content inventories/private targets/probes/baseline outputs and scoring metadata before freeze.
All final per-seed outcomes, metrics, confidence intervals and claim assessments remain sealed from optimization; final execution reveals only permitted training data and prediction covariates.

required_evidence: Complete research paper PDF and LaTeX in the latest official ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS template within its main-text limit with required checklist; abstract, introduction, actual-read related work, method, experiments, discussion, limitations, real references. Do not access or infer prohibited research or derivative pages; log accidental encounters.

All reported numbers, figures and tables must come from actual included reproducible code runs; exact dependency environment, licenses, seeds, commands, runtime and script-to-figure mapping. Disclose failed/incomplete/abandoned runs. Offline CPython3.12 Linux x86_64 and pinned NumPy2.1.3; no paid API. Native requires Landlock ABI4 and seccomp BPF; harness isolates broker runtime. Report generation separately needs official conference template and TeX, not evaluated or fabricated by scaffold.

Separate scientific validity, search eligibility and final claim review. No task-authorized comparative search threshold exists. Negative and inconclusive results accepted; finite-sample marginal coverage only under exchangeability with a training-frozen score and ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) order statistic. Shift and subgroup coverage have no automatic guarantee.

Raw original synthetic examples and covariate hashes before transforms: finite-f64le canonicalization without IDs/tags or rounding, signed zero normalized; source IDs, row split offsets and RNG lineages. Draft cross-plane content check and runtime own-plane checks; no artificially duplicated immutable code or model weights. Reuse only across matched methods and controls. Smoke streams independently generated.

Per-case/seed/alpha marginal and fixed x0 subgroup Wilson intervals, reference-mass Monte Carlo intervals and zero-hit limitations, actual/baseline/control effects with deterministic2000-resample paired-seed intervals and few-seed/multiplicity caveats. Reference is an equal uniform-simplex/training-fitted logistic-normal mixture, 128 response-independent test covariates with1024 probes; smoke8covariates32probes. No claim of intrinsic volume.

All matched controls executed: zero-input constant/global equivalence, content-changing deranged training residuals without demanded effect direction, copy-center singleton membership and full-simplex exact sanity; terminal actual replay within rtol1e-10 atol1e-12. Missing controls infeasible, failed scientific invariances invalid; do not infer learning from self-reports or changed hashes.

Exact production reset order case-major H3,H10,B3,B10,S3,S10 then seed then actual/constant/permuted, followed by one declared H3 actual replay. 55search/109final episodes; one reset and3logical ops each. Transfer maximum per logical op: begin1 upload2 commit1 export_start1 fetch2 release1=8; episode25; totals1375/2725. Direct transcripts220/436. No other replay permitted. Fallback <=8MiB raw each direction, chunks4MiB, two chunks max, candidate-owned memory<=32MiB. All complete modeled JSON messages including base64, envelope and4096-byte framing reserve are strictly below8MiB safety target and64MiB broker limit. No shared paths.

Trusted full workload wall/CPU/memory and RPC/reset traces; startup30s and finish30s reserved inside1200/2400s. Per baseline case-seed10s, candidate episode10s, reset1s, RPC3s, cleanup1.5s per episode (terminate.2+kill/reap.2+stderr1+bookkeeping.1). Joint work and remaining-reset reservations checked before execution. Aggregate8cores16GiB; evaluator6cores10GiB, candidate2cores6GiB; BLAS1thread; CPU limits wall*threads; no GPU. Productive numerical baselines measured separately from imports/reset/cleanup; no canonical minimum productive-time floor exists.

Frozen candidate/interface/dependency/contract evidence and self-contained sealed final evaluation. Full failure denominators maintained; no missing case/control renormalization, no candidate internal flags used, no fabricated telemetry. Search and final correct predicates separate from publication claims. Public smoke only execution evidence, not full feasibility; hard schema first-production-seed smoke rule supersedes design smoke-only seed labels with independent raw streams.
